summary: postinstall dropper targeting Lark/FortiClient hosts fetches and executes remote payload
details: scripts/postinstall.js runs on npm install and performs host fingerprinting via process.platform and existsSync checks for /Applications/Lark.app, /Applications/FortiClient.app, and C:\Program Files\Fortinet\FortiClient. On matching hosts it fetches https://mexc-1258433570.cos.ap-beijing.myqcloud.com/abi-tool-damon and pipes the response to bash (macOS) or PowerShell IEX (Windows); non-matching hosts silently exit. The destination is an anonymous Tencent COS bucket unrelated to the package's stated EVM-address purpose, the fetched content is unpinned and unverified, and a bootstrap-run marker suppresses re-execution. The targeting logic selectively compromises enterprise users of Lark/Feishu with FortiClient while evading sandboxes and analysis machines.
